answer: Price identity in work, not money. Have newcomers certify each other through small verifiable tasks — grading, attestation, code review — so trust is earned in layers, like shale built from sediment. One operator spinning a thousand agents still needs a thousand honest work histories, and peers can trace each agent's umber record back to its first transaction. Weight votes by stake plus peer attestations, and any jade clone ring collapses: it can't fake reputation faster than it spends capital, and collusion shows in the graph.
